name: gha-indie-worker-infra

ORES_CLI_READ_TOKEN.description: Fine-grained GitHub token with read-only Contents access to private ORESoftware/ores-cli, used only to install oresc in this cross-org Codespace.

TUNNEL_TOKEN.description: Cloudflare named-tunnel connector token consumed by oresc codespace edge up.

postCreateCommand: bash -euc 'if ! command -v oresc >/dev/null 2>&1; then test -n "${ORES_CLI_READ_TOKEN:-}" || { echo >&2 "ORES_CLI_READ_TOKEN is required to install private ORESoftware/ores-cli in this cross-org Codespace"; exit 78; }; GH_TOKEN="$ORES_CLI_READ_TOKEN" gh auth setup-git >/dev/null; GH_TOKEN="$ORES_CLI_READ_TOKEN" CARGO_NET_GIT_FETCH_WITH_CLI=true cargo install --locked --git https://github.com/ORESoftware/ores-cli.git --rev 3d65e4dbdeeed04bfa7d8f8d64a5681b41157a90 --bin oresc; fi; cargo run --locked --manifest-path tools/dev-runtime/Cargo.toml -- validate; just codespace-edge-check'
